def countDivisors(n: int) -> int:
    p = n
    q = 0  # mutable binding for result
    i = 1
    while i <= p:
        if p % i == 0:
            q += 1
        i += 1
    return q

def main() -> None:
    # Test case 1: n = 1 (edge case, smallest positive integer)
    print(countDivisors(1))
    
    # Test case 2: n = 2 (prime number)
    print(countDivisors(2))
    
    # Test case 3: n = 12 (multiple divisors)
    print(countDivisors(12))
    
    # Test case 4: n = 36 (perfect square)
    print(countDivisors(36))
    
    # Test case 5: n = 100 (boundary-like value)
    print(countDivisors(100))
    
    # Test case 6: n = 97 (prime number)
    print(countDivisors(97))
    
    # Test case 7: n = 144 (larger perfect square)
    print(countDivisors(144))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
